# Contact

We are constantly looking for passionate people to join the M!ND Lab. If you are interested in our work and want to know more about potential open positions, send me an email describing how your interests are aligned with the lab, any relevant prior experiences, and what you'd like to do if you were to join the lab.

The lab is located at the [Institut de Neurosciences de la Timone](https://www.int.univ-amu.fr/en/int-research) on the Aix-Marseille University campus in the center of Marseille, one of the most vibrant cities in Europe, with direct access to the Mediterranean Sea, close to the Alps and the Pyrenees, and equally close to Italy and Spain.
